description_en: Creates a notification recipient for a project
name: CreateProjectNotifyReceiver

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462953.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462953.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The project ID.
You can call the ListProjects operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
项目ID。
您可以调用ListProjects接口获取该参数
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the recipient. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, cannot start with a special character, and can contain only the following special characters: periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), backslashes (), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 接收人名称。长度为1-128个字符，不能以特殊字符开头，只可包含特殊字符中的'.'、'_'、'-'、'\'以及空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The phone number of the recipient.
You must specify at least one of Phone or Email
parameters.help_zh:
接收人手机号。
手机号和邮箱至少需填写一项
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en:
The email address of the recipient.
You must specify at least one of Phone or Email
parameters.help_zh:
接收人邮箱。
手机号和邮箱至少需填写一项
parameters.name: email

ReceiverId.description_en: The ID of the notification recipient

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
